common_dataset.reason: same broad index and same timestamped OHLC source can support all three shallow mechanism screens without cross-asset or constituent complications

2015-01-05_to_2025-12-31.reason: this entire interval was already consumed by prior legacy overnight-open research; the broad program may reuse it for mechanism development but may never relabel it fresh

2026-01-05_to_2026-08-21.reason: legacy repeat/consumed evidence and not required for the equal-budget shallow screen

2026-08-24_to_2026-12-31.reason: preserved legacy true-fresh reserve; broad Stage1 may not spend it

broad_program_future_audit.rule: no R1_R2_R3 lane may call development-slice stability a fresh audit; any deep identity must freeze a genuinely unseen future challenge separately

common_volatility_unit.formula: std(log(close_d/close_d-1), ddof=0) over the 20 completed China sessions strictly before the current session
common_volatility_unit.availability: frozen at each session open from prior completed sessions only

completed_wave_engine.confirmation_rule: a provisional extreme becomes a completed pivot only after price reverses from that extreme by the scale threshold available causally at the confirmation time
completed_wave_engine.overnight_gap_treatment: price path remains chronological across sessions; the first observed next-session minute may move the causal directional-change state but no synthetic overnight bars are inserted
completed_wave_engine.event_overlap_rule: within each lane and scale pairing keep at most one active first-passage outcome event at a time; later triggers are counted as overlap_skipped until the active event resolves or censors

scale_policy.why_two_pairings: common contract requires scale sensitivity; two fixed 3x-separated directional-change pairings provide one faster and one slower view without a threshold grid

common_outcome_cap.rule: first structural/symmetric boundary hit wins; if neither boundary is reached by the cap the event is censored
